Takes a version number and returns the corresponding namespace.

== Examples ==
50.03: {{ns|50.03}}

0.43.05: {{ns|0.43.05}}

0.44: {{ns|0.44}} (trailing components not required)

0.34.11: {{ns|0.34.11}}

0.34.02: {{ns|0.34.02}}

0.31.19: {{ns|0.31.19}}

v0.31.07: {{ns|v0.31.07}} (Leading "v" is ignored)

0.28.121.40c: {{ns|0.28.121.40c}}

0.23.130.23a: {{ns|0.23.130.23a}}

unrecognized: {{ns|unrecognized}}

==See also==
{{tl|nsv}} (the inverse of this template)

{{ns|{{nsv|DF2012}}}}
